column4: K. K. Piyadasa Foundation  (Incorporation)
to advise and assist all communities in Sri lanka to
live in peace and harmony;
to establish information technology centers for the
advancement of scientific studies;
to  organize  and  operate  educational  tours,
shramadana campaigns and workshops in order to
inculcate  feelings  on  Sri  Lankan  heritage,
environment, wildlife, population and patriotism;
to  implement  academic  and  training  programs
relevant for enviornment conservation of rural areas;
to  encourage  farmers  engaged  in  traditional  and
export  agricultural  activities  and  to  carry  out
various awareness programs for them;
to  implement  social  mobilization  programs  and

educational  and 
training  programs  for 
the
development of the children and women;
to assist in the development of religious, cultural,
aestheticd  and  sports  facilities  without  any
discrimination to race, religion or caste;
to promote discipline and cultural ethics necessary
and to make provisions to maintain it;
to  promote  artistic  creations,  sports  skills  and
technical knowledge of school leavers and set up
vocational  training  centers;  and
to liaise and co-ordinate with other local or foreign
institutions which have similar objects.
